verdict.rationale: Writing vault entries programmatically is a fair question for an authenticator and credential app, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents manual, in-app ways to add entries: scanning a QR code, entering a code by hand, and exporting or importing passwords through the app's settings. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and nothing describes an API, CLI or SDK an agent could use to seed TOTP secrets or store credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
